adjudication.rationale: In app/controllers/groups_controller.rb#members, the diff introduces `limit = (params[:limit] || 50).to_i` and uses it directly in `group.users...limit(limit).offset(offset)` with no clamping/validation. This allows very large limits (potentially returning an excessive number of members in one response) and also allows `limit=0` (or negative values) which then propagates back to the client via `meta.limit`. The admin controller computes `currentPage`/`totalPages` using `offset / limit` (admin-group.js.es6), so a `limit` of 0 causes division-by-zero leading to invalid pagination values (Infinity/NaN-like broken UI state). This is a concrete behavior enabled by the changed code paths.
